provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: H, theta_pbc are computed/extracted (L35, L37) but never used in the plot.
audit_member_text: theta_pbc at L35 and aggregate H at L37 are computed but never used; the figure compares no PBC-direction series despite parsing it.

base_member_text: xlim mixes radians and degrees: [-pi/2+theta_mean*pi/180-0.2 ...] is scaled by 180/pi (L47), while the xlabel says theta (rad) and xticks are set at degree values -90:22.5:90 (L58, L62) — units on the axis are inconsistent unless theta_in is in degrees.
audit_member_text: Angle-unit mismatch across L46-L62: theta_in is plotted against degree tick values -90..90 and x limits explicitly convert radians to degrees at L47, but the x-axis label at L58 says radians.

base_member_text: freq_resolution uses length(f_i) instead of length(f_i)-1 (L42), a fencepost approximation.
audit_member_text: Likely bin-width off-by-one at L42: for N samples spanning f_i(1) through f_i(end) with both endpoints included, uniform spacing is span/(N-1), but the code divides by N, inflating E_i at L43 by N/(N-1). Irregular or singleton f_i is also unhandled.

base_member_text: The fixed character slices (6:12, 16:24, 28:36; L13-L17) depend on the exact LOG.txt formatting of the FUNWAVE-TVD directional wavemaker output block; any format change breaks the parser silently (str2double returns NaN).
audit_member_text: Fixed-column parsing at L13-L17 assumes minimum line lengths of 36 and 12 characters and silently converts malformed fields to NaN; there is no length or finite-value validation before downstream arithmetic.

base_member_text: The header match makes i=1 for every occurrence (L20-L23), so the parser reads only the first data line after each header occurrence and the following line as amplitude — it assumes exactly one component per header repetition; the actual LOG structure is not visible here.
E_i normalization by pi (L43) implies a directional bin of pi radians spread; the derivation of this constant is not stated.
fp=0.1 and theta_mean=0 (L38-L39) are hardcoded assumptions about the case's peak frequency and mean direction.

audit_member_text: EOF/order defect across L10-L25: tline is sliced at L13-L17 or passed to strfind at L20 before the non-character EOF test at L25. A header without both following fixed-width data lines can therefore index the numeric EOF sentinel or a short line before EOF is recognized.

Use-before-assignment path across L7-L28 and L30: if no matching header/data block is parsed, output is never created but output(:,4) is immediately read. fopen failure at L5 is also unchecked, and fid is never closed.
The figures directory used at L64 and L70 is not created or checked before saveas.
